description: Opens with a challenge or difficult task — creates curiosity about whether it can be completed
mechanism: Audience drawn to watching someone overcome difficulty or wondering if they could do it
example_easeui: Can I build a complete design system in 24 hours using only AI?
anti_pattern: Challenge too easy (no stakes) or too unrealistic (loses credibility)

description: Uses a shocking statement, harsh truth, or pain point to grab attention
mechanism: Humans naturally pay attention to negative or controversial signals
example_easeui: Here's why your design system is actually making your team SLOWER
anti_pattern: Being genuinely offensive or spreading misinformation — always pivot to solution

description: Promises to reveal a secret, surprise, or anticipated result later
mechanism: Creates suspense and anticipation — viewer stays to discover what's hidden
example_easeui: The one decision that saved EaseUI 3 months of development time
anti_pattern: Overpromising and underdelivering — the reveal must be worth the wait

description: Places an object/character/situation in a completely unexpected context
mechanism: Bizarre or illogical imagery immediately captures attention and triggers curiosity
example_easeui: A Figma file in a museum — 'This is what design handoff feels like in 2026'
anti_pattern: Being random without connecting to brand message

description: Opens with tension, conflict, or a intense emotional moment
mechanism: Drama evokes emotions and curiosity about what happens next
example_easeui: 'We're going to have to rebuild everything from scratch.' The Slack message that changed my approach to design systems.

description: Uses open questions, intriguing claims, or partial reveals to stimulate natural curiosity
mechanism: Triggers the human need to know more and get the complete picture
example_easeui: What happens when you give an AI your entire design system as context?
anti_pattern: Questions too generic ('Want to be successful?') or clickbait without substance

description: Uses fast-paced, high-energy, or risk-taking opening scenes
example_easeui: Speed-building: Watch me go from prompt to production component in 60 seconds
anti_pattern: Overused energy without substance — exhausting rather than engaging
